transactions.asset: Vmware, Inc. Common stock, Class A
transactions.description: On November 27 2023 Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ: AVGO), a global technology leader that designs, develops, and supplies semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, acquired VMware, Inc. Broadcom Inc. re-purchased all VMware Class A stock holdings from portfolios that had less than a 100 shares. The total proceeds for the VMware stock re- purchase were deposited in the IRA Morgan Stanley Money Market Fund as reported on Schedule A
